column1: # Mapping of ChatGPT Project IDs to human-readable names.
# Copy this file to `project_names.tsv` and fill in your own projects. That
# filename is git-ignored, because the mapping is account data -- your project
# ids and the names you gave them -- rather than code.
# Two places the pipeline looks, in order:
#   1. `--rename-tsv <path>`, which the per-corpus wrapper passes when a
# Without either, the rename step says so and the folders keep their raw ids.
# Format: <project_id><TAB><human_name>. A REAL tab, not spaces.
# Lines starting with # are comments; blank lines are ignored.
# Find an id by opening the project in ChatGPT: the URL shows /g/g-p-XXXX/project.
# Custom GPTs work the same way, with `gpt_g-` ids.
# If two projects share a name, the folder names collide -- disambiguate here
